rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to say that someone is awake rather than asleep.

example.english: Stay awake and wait for me to come back before going to sleep.
example.traditional: 你醒住等我返嚟先瞓啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 seng2 zyu6 dang2 ngo5 faan1 lei4 sin1 fan3 laa1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that someone is conscious and mentally alert, rather than merely not asleep.

example.english: They have had a few drinks, but they are still mentally awake.
example.traditional: 佢飲咗幾杯，但係仲好清醒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jam2 zo2 gei2 bui1 daan6 hai6 zung6 hou2 cing1 sing2
